rundown: Steelers beat Broncos 27-5 at Acrisure Stadium in Pittsburgh, PA. Steelers led 24-5 at the half and never looked back. The 1st quarter decided it: Steelers won it 14-0.
Scoring: Broncos 0 touchdowns and 1 field goal; Steelers 2 touchdowns and 2 field goals. The last score: Chris Boswell 33 Yd Field Goal (4th quarter, 11:16).

Leading the way — Broncos: Bo Nix 22/40, 169 yds, 2 INT; Cody Schrader 7 car, 27 yds; Jaylen Waddle 5 rec, 53 yds. Steelers: Mason Rudolph 9/15, 142 yds, 1 TD; Rico Dowdle 11 car, 71 yds; Germie Bernard 1 rec, 58 yds.
Where Steelers won it: they outgained them 247 yards to 205 and won the turnover battle (1 to 3).

Against the closing line (DraftKings): Broncos closed as 4.5-point favorites and lost outright to Steelers; Steelers won as the underdog at +202; the total closed at 36.5 and they combined for 32, under by 4.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 27, 2:55 PM ET. It had Broncos 60% and Steelers 40%, projecting Broncos 21.1 – Steelers 17.8 (38.9 total, Broncos by 3.3).

Final: Broncos 5 – Steelers 27. Wrong winner: it had Broncos at 60%, and Steelers (40%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Broncos came in with a 3% above average attack and a 11% stingier than average defense (8-2, 23.6 scored and 21 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 54 and 54 games of evidence. Projected to score 21.1, they scored 5 (−16.1 points, 76% under); projected to allow 17.8, they allowed 27 (+9.2 points, 52% over).

Steelers came in with a 2% below average attack and a 8% stingier than average defense (6-4, 21.4 scored and 20.1 allowed a game over 10 games), worth about 53 and 56 games of evidence. Projected to score 17.8, they scored 27 (+9.2 points, 52% over); projected to allow 21.1, they allowed 5 (−16.1 points, 76% under).

The bigger miss was Broncos' scoring (-16.1 points against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 32 against 38.9 projected (-6.9), about the 30th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±13.2).

Margin: Steelers by 22 against Broncos by 3.3 projected, about the 98th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12.8).

An unusual result, but one the simulations saw regularly (roughly one game in six to one in twenty).

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Weather (40°F · ? mph wind): Steelers ×0.94, Broncos ×0.94. Market (Line movement signal): Steelers ×1.00, Broncos ×1.02. It favored Broncos, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
PIT ML (+198) at +198: the algo gave it 33% vs 32% fair (+0.7 pts) — won (+2u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 32%). DEN ML (-239) at -239: the algo gave it 67% vs 68% fair (-0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 68%). PIT +4.5 (-103) at -103: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (+0.8 pts) — won (+1u); same number as the close. DEN -4.5 (-116) at -116: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (-0.8 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 36.5 (-112) at -112: the algo gave it 51% vs 51% fair (+0.7 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. UNDER 36.5 (-107) at -107: the algo gave it 49% vs 49% fair (-0.7 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close.

The line barely moved between the algo's snapshot and the close.

No bet: nothing cleared the algo's bar before the game.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 81% of bets on Broncos, 74% of the money — Steelers covered; total: 72% of bets on the over, 68% of the money — it went under; moneyline: 87% of bets on Broncos, 81% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Broncos, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.813 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +24.3 points. It counts toward NFL scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 60 graded NFL games the algo now scales scoring ×0.984 and gives home teams -0.8 points. Team corrections so far: Broncos attack ×0.960, defense ×1.040 (3 games); Steelers attack ×0.991, defense ×0.964 (4 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin outside its normal range (off by 25.3 points), no bet.
